# Appcellent

> Appcellent is a small app studio that makes simple utility apps for iPhone, iPad and Android: Stud Finder, Protractor, TCG Vault, Volume Booster, Colorzy and Decibel Meter. Each app does one job. All are free to download; some offer an optional subscription for extra features. The company is Appcellent Yazılım Hizmetleri A.Ş. (Nilüfer, Bursa, Türkiye).

Each app has its own website with guides and free web tools. Release notes for every app are on one page: https://appcellent.com/updates

## Apps

- [Stud Finder](https://thestudfinder.app/): finds the screws and nails that sit along wall studs with the phone's magnetic sensor, with sound and vibration. iPhone and Android. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6740814424) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=co.appcellent.studfinder)
- [Protractor](https://protractorapp.com/): measures angles with the camera, the edge of the phone or by touch; bubble level and inclinometer built in. iPhone and Android. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6742701087) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=co.appcellent.protractor)
- [TCG Vault](https://tcgvault.io/): scans trading cards (Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh! and more), shows market prices and tracks the value of a collection. iPhone and iPad. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758110523)
- [Volume Booster](https://thevolumebooster.app/): makes music and videos louder, with bass boost, a 6-band equalizer and playback speed control. iPhone and Android. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760180638) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.appcellent.volumebooster)
- [Colorzy](https://coloringmaker.app/): turns a photo or an idea into a printable coloring page with AI, plus ready-made templates. iPhone and iPad. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6772468073)
- [Decibel Meter](https://noiselevel.app/): a sound level meter with A, C and Z weighting, noise dose tracking and saved measurements. iPhone. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6793045784)

## Help

- [Help Center](https://appcellent.com/help): answers for every app
- [Cancel a subscription](https://appcellent.com/help/cancel-subscription): subscriptions are billed by Apple or Google and cancelled in the store account
- [Request a refund](https://appcellent.com/help/request-a-refund): refunds are issued by Apple or Google, not by the developer
- [Restore purchases](https://appcellent.com/help/restore-purchases)
- [App not working](https://appcellent.com/help/app-not-working)
- [Contact support](https://appcellent.com/support): support@appcellent.com; partnerships and press: contact@appcellent.com
